takeaways: The strongest unused CSMP material is the June 2023 4K pair, HIbachi.mov and Mediterranean Chicken wrap.mov (both 4). Their shallow-focus food macros are the best food cinematography in the chunk. Crop out the top-right logo and use them as vertical hero-loop stacks, and use them on work/csmp. They should replace CSMP Spotlight 1.mp4 and 2.mp4, the two static talking-head videos now on work/csmp; the second shows a man behind plastic grocery bags. Vince Expert In The Kitchen and Eggplant Chermoula have strong macros for blog:themed-content-calendar-food-brands. The best Influencer in the Kitchen episodes (Grain Bowl Final, Alfredo, Stir Fry Tofu) can prove service:influencer-marketing. Most of the rest (Nov 2022 to Mar 2023) is static talking to camera in a drop-ceiling office, with dated letterboxing or kinetic text. The template folders are placeholder-only, and the Client Testimonial set has a 'TESTIMONAL' typo, so none of it belongs on the site.
